title: SKU reliability assessment
description: Evaluates resource SKUs against availability requirements, identifying single points of failure or SLA gaps.
example_prompt: "For resources in production tagged 'SLA=99.99%', check: (1) VM — is it using Availability Zones or VMSS? (2) SQL — is it Zone-redundant? (3) Storage — is it GRS/GZRS? (4) App Service — is it Premium or in ASE? Flag any resource where SKU SLA is below the stated target."
